title: Gary McFarland's string writing
summary: Kirchner proposes records Sauter has not heard.

story.theme_name: Writing and arranging: how musicians compose
story.community_name: Writing, arranging and composing: how the music gets made

blocks.x: Did you ever hear some of the things that Gary McFarland did for string?
I heard Gary McFarland, but I don't really recall anything like that. In what context?
Varied context. He did one record for Zoot with a large string ensemble which was gorgeous.
I'll have to bring it over sometime.
He also did things for string
quartet and piano bass drums trio. There was one record with Bill Evans with two violas, cello, Phil Woods playing clarinet, Spencer Sinatra playing alto flute and then the rhythm section.
Yeah, in all cases, and really well so that there was a really natural sound.
I'll have to reserve judgement; I have to hear that.
I'll have to bring that over.
I never heard it that I felt it was right.

I guess it's becoming more of a problem now because of the music education movement, as far as jazz education, and they want to get string players involved in something more than the usual static, playing whole notes in the
Good string players feel insulted by that.
